qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Integrated energy producer with strong exploration capabilities and satellite model (Plenitude, Enilive); however, Eni is fundamentally a commodity price-taker subject to volatile global hydrocarbon benchmarks. 5-year normalized ROIC is sub-hurdle (~8% normalized, dropping to 7.6% in 2024 and negative in 2020). Lacks pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Commodity price-taker with normalized ROIC (~8%) well below the 12% cycle hurdle. Realized earnings fluctuate with global crude and European gas prices, subject to Italian state influence and windfall taxes.
qualitative.evidence: Eni is an integrated oil and gas major controlled ~30% by the Italian state. Financial track record shows volatile, sub-hurdle returns on capital: adjusted ROACE of 8.4% (2019), -0.6% (2020), 12.3% (2021), 22.0% (2022 windfall), 12.3% (2023), and 7.6% (2024). Pricing is dictated entirely by spot markets, and heavy capital intensity prevents sustained value creation above the cost of capital.
